prior_results.continuous_boundary_policy: 0/4 retained; derived tables recovered; raw supplement archive unavailable in current workspace/verified remote tree

question: Does a cost-sensitive policy objective improve the existing frozen native sparse encoder's 42-coefficient action readout relative to matched iterative Q regression?

arms.name: ridge_reference
arms.role: whole-training-program engineering reference, not isolated loss effect

primary_pair.method: two-sided paired-seed Student t interval; lower bound > 0.005 and zero stability failures

fixed_native.kernel: unchanged original sparse_tick and original NDU from 5898cd8b0f724c3152b6cc52856721f72e5e08be
fixed_native.activation_source: actual NativeBridge.kernel_batch, never a Python sparse emulator
fixed_native.task_features: all 18 continuous_boundary_policy.FEATURE_NAMES; native_rows supplies 17 raw plus typed margin/risk/flow, with two duplicates
fixed_native.boundary: same finite-grid value boundary for all arms
fixed_native.state_reset: native state starts at episode beginning; no new hidden reset at repair/failure

matched_iterative_training.regularization_definition: lambda * mean of 40 nonbias coefficients squared; both biases unpenalized
matched_iterative_training.score_map: same affine keep/repair scores; STOP=0; no tanh or score clamp
matched_iterative_training.q_mse: mean over N x 2 of (affine_score - physical_Q/8)^2
matched_iterative_training.policy_objective: teacher-action CE at temperature 1 plus sum_a softmax(score)_a * (max Q - Q_a)/(1+max_a(max Q-Q_a))
matched_iterative_training.quantization: same make_profile round(value*2^24); no straight-through estimator; exact per-product signed ties-even native readout; no score clamp
matched_iterative_training.shared_inputs: same saved actual native activation matrix and physical DP Q for every candidate and arm
matched_iterative_training.split_verification: low-level fit does not verify split provenance; future study runner must enforce it
matched_iterative_training.active_parameter_reporting: 42 allocated trainable coefficients; report observed active columns and nonzero-gradient coordinates rather than claiming every coefficient receives data gradient

data_plan.context_generator: unchanged continuous_boundary_flow.scenarios; fresh seed and phase-specific streams
data_plan.shared_uniforms: fixed per seed/context/path/time/action slot across arms
data_plan.old_confirmation_use: arithmetic parity only, never training, development selection, or a new efficacy sample
data_plan.behavior: unchanged continuous_boundary_flow.execution.behavior_data: every window keep probability 0.8, repair probability 0.2, no exploratory STOP, complete declared horizon
data_plan.row_weights: equal weight for each observed training window; no padding, class reweighting, objective-dependent resampling, or different activation matrices
data_plan.teacher_units: behavior_data.target_q is already physical keep/repair Q divided by 8; future runner must multiply by 8 and append literal-zero STOP before head.fit; ridge takes physical Q/8 exactly once

selection: maximum actual-native mean development net utility; smallest candidate index breaks ties; exactly three candidates per learned arm; source/protocol/binary publication before training and selection publication before confirmation

policy_visitation: Brier and fixed-bin ECE of common analytic after-action first-passage predictor
diagnostics.same_state_panel: same held-out diagnostic exploratory trajectories with recorded native activations for all arms; report physical DP action regret conditional on teacher keep/repair/stop; no hyperparameter selection
quantization: float diagnostic argmax vs original NDU action disagreement
signed delta regret on the same state: regret(Q24/NDU action) - regret(float diagnostic action); preserve negative values and report flips separately
diagnostics.multiplicity: all diagnostics descriptive; no secondary benefit claims without a separately frozen testing family
diagnostics.calibration_bins: 10 fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; empty exposure yields undefined calibration; also report episode-equal and window-weighted Brier

costs.train: separate shared exploration/model/DP/native feature export, per-candidate fitting, and development rollouts
costs.runtime: actual original kernel/NDU calls, whole rollout CPU/wall and serialization, numeric bytes and full request/response bytes
costs.native_child_cpu: included once in enclosing nonoverlapping windows
costs.solver: record model construction and DP separately, avoid double-counting shared setup
costs.fit_receipt_scope: head.fit internal clock starts after initial input validation/array allocation; includes later fit computations and hashing; enclosing future runner must separately measure full phase

release_gates: integrate a new runner with strict phase/source/binary/manifest identity verification
rebuild and validate original native host; bind new exact binary rather than claiming the lost binary was recovered
perform native integration preflight on diagnostic-only seeds
format and publish exact new source/protocol/binary seal before training
publish development selection seal before opening confirmation
retain all attempts, raw records, models, costs and failures in a verified retrievable archive
failure_policy: abort and preserve; no seed extension, sample exclusion, threshold changes, or revisiting selection after confirmation
authority: research only; DENY_ALL; no production promotion or main-branch merge
execution_so_far: only numerical loss/gradient tests and replay of already published old Q24 readout records; no new native process or new efficacy samples
